```{r}
z <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/Data_files_export/bodydata.txt",header=TRUE)
tmp <- rep(0,nrow(z))
tmp[z$Gender == "M"] <- 1
z$Gender <- tmp
logit <- glm(Gender ~ .,data=z,family=binomial)

prob <- predict(logit,data=z,type="response")
predicted <- ifelse(prob > 0.5,"M","F")
table(predicted,z$Gender)
```

```{r}
lm1 <- lm(Gender ~ .,data=z)
summary(lm1)
prob <- predict(lm1,data=z)
predicted <- ifelse(prob > 0.5,"M","F")
table(predicted,z$Gender)
```
